title: Repair cooperative inbox
brief: Build a self-contained HTML repair-request inbox that adapts between desktop and mobile. Let staff read a request and mark it resolved.
context: Three open requests: R17 Maya / bicycle brake cable; R18 Ivo / desk lamp switch; R19 Lin / kettle handle. Start in Open. At 1280x800 show list/detail; at 390x844 use one active content pane. Include Open and Resolved destinations.

user_facts.primary_task: Resolve a request after reading it

constraints: Use Material adaptive layout ideas without requiring a framework installation.
Changing viewport must preserve request state.

checks.criterion: Resolve R18: it leaves Open and appears in Resolved with the same requester and issue.
Select R17 at wide width, switch to compact width, and still have a usable path to R17 and the other requests.
The currently active destination and selected request are visually distinguishable.
Request identity, issue and resolution action are grouped so the action scope is unambiguous.
